# Zod reference fixtures

`zod-v1.json` and `zod-v2.json` contain results captured from the TypeScript SDK
commit recorded in `../typescript/REVISION`, using **Zod 4.5.4** (the SDK lockfile
version when captured) and Node.js 24. Each entry is the result of
`schema.safeParse(input)` using the named export from that version's `zod.gen.ts`.
Successful `output` values are serialized with `JSON.stringify`, so JavaScript
`undefined` properties are omitted.

The cases cover defaults, missing versus null, required fields, numeric bounds,
lenient fields/arrays, pattern and format checks, reserved union tags and custom
payload preservation. They run in the normal Go suite without Node.js. Additional
synthetic fixtures under `internal/cmd/schema/tsgen/testdata` test code generation
and combinations not present in the pinned SDK.

To refresh, install Zod at the upstream lockfile version in a temporary directory,
copy each pinned `zod.gen.ts` there, rewrite its schema-deserialize import to the
pinned `../typescript/schema-deserialize.ts`, and run `safeParse` for each fixture's
`schema` and `input`. Use Node's TypeScript stripping support. Review changed
outcomes before updating expected results; these fixtures are not generated by
`go generate`.
